READING Recommended time: 40 minutes (30 points) Imagine you are choosing dry food for your dog. Below is the information you read on a bag of dog food. Read the information and do the following tasks. NEW
AND IMPROVED Grade A Dog Chow

A new and improved line of dog food that combines the flavor of real beef with all the essential minerals needed for a happy and healthy life. Veterinarians agree that this is the dog food to buy. Essential Minerals – Grade A Dog Chow provides your dog with 12 essential minerals for good health. This means that Grade A Dog Chow has three more minerals than is recommended by the National Canine Council. For example, Grade A Dog Chow contains zinc for healthy skin, calcium for stronger bones, and sodium for proper kidney function. Real Beef – Grade A Dog Chow contains real beef. Most kinds of dog food are flavored with beef, but actually contain little or no real beef at all. Look at the list of ingredients on the container of your dog’s food. If beef is not the first ingredient listed, then beef is not the main ingredient. We guarantee that Grade A Dog Chow is the only dog food on the market that lists beef first. Disease Protection – Grade A Dog Chow is the first and only dog food that provides your dog with protection from heartworm. Heartworm medication is in the dog food. If your dog eats the recommended amount of food each day, it will receive the maximum protection needed to prevent this dreaded canine disease. Convenient Packaging – Grade A Dog Chow comes in convenient one-serving size or in 20-pound bags. Reasonable Price – Grade A Dog Chow is the best dog food for your money. We guarantee your dog will not only like our dog food but eat it with gusto, or we’ll give you your money back! 3

Underwater Games Have you ever seen dolphins? Dolphins are mammals that (0) ___ in seas and oceans. Dolphins are smart animals, but they are (1) ___ curious and playful. Many scientists (11) ___ filmed and photographed dolphins playing with bubble rings. Sometimes (12) ___ looks like dolphins use the bubble rings as targets. They will hit the bubbles with their long noses or spin around and slap the bubbles with their tails. Dolphins also try to bite the bubbles. (13) ___, dolphins use bubble rings to create more of a challenge. (14) ___ playful mammals will make a big bubble ring and try to swim through it. They have been seen trying to catch a bubble ring or move it around without breaking it. Sometimes they can (15) ___ two or three bubble rings together. It is (16) ___ fun game for the dolphins! (17) ___ experts think that dolphins also use bubble rings to help them hunt for food. Dolphins swim beneath the fish and send up bubbles. The bubbles cause the fish to move toward the surface of the water. (18) ___ the dolphins swim in and grab a tasty snack. It is amazing (19) ___ dolphins play with bubble rings. It does not matter if dolphins use bubble rings to help them hunt for food or use them just for fun. What matters (20) ___ dolphins have fun playing with all the bubbles they make. 7

paras: ВСЕРОССИЙСКАЯ ОЛИМПИАДА ШКОЛЬНИКОВ АНГЛИЙСКИЙ ЯЗЫК. 2024–2025 уч. г. ШКОЛЬНЫЙ ЭТАП. 7–8 КЛАССЫ ТЕКСТ ДЛЯ АУДИРОВАНИЯ Listening Comprehension Listen to the dialogue between Agnes and her grandfather and decide whether the statements (1–5) are TRUE, FALSE or this information is not provided in the text – NOT STATED – according to the dialogue you hear. You will hear the text twice. Now you have 15 seconds to read the statements. (Pause 15 seconds) Now we begin. Agnes: Hey, Grandpa! What are you looking at? Who is this boy in this old photo? Ah! Is it you? Why are you swimming in boiling water? How are you still alive? Grandfather: It’s not boiling, silly! It’s just warm. It’s the cold temperature outside that makes all that steam. This is an outdoor swimming pool in Moscow. It was about minus thirty Celsius that day in January 1975. Agnes: You went to Moscow in 1975? Grandfather: I did! I was in my early 20s and an art student. There was this great museum in the very center of Moscow where I spent hours every day. Then I crossed the street and swam in this outdoor swimming pool. And guess what the air smelled like! Agnes: Chlorine? Grandfather: Chocolates! Agnes: No! Grandfather: Yes! There was a chocolate factory across the river from the swimming pool. And the air around it smelled so good! Why don’t we go to Moscow for the Christmas holidays? Agnes: That would be cool! Grandfather: Listen, Agnes, do you have your phone with you? Google Swimming Pool “Moskva”! Agnes: Sure! Let’s see… Hey, it doesn’t exist anymore! Grandfather: What do you mean? Agnes: There is this huge church that was built in its place. Grandfather: Really? Hmm!... Agnes: Wow, Grandpa! I’ve just googled swimming in winter in Moscow. There is this cool Walrus club – they cut a huge hole in the ice in a forest lake and swim in icy water! I've never heard of anything so cool! Let’s do that! Grandfather: You think your parents would allow you?
Всероссийская олимпиада школьников. Английский язык. 2024-2025 уч г. Школьный этап. 7-8 классы. Текст для аудирования

Agnes: We won’t tell them! Grandfather: Hey, Agnes, google that chocolate factory! It was called Red October. Does it still exist? Agnes: Let’s see… It does exist, but … they moved it away from the center of Moscow. Grandfather: No! It doesn’t smell like chocolates there anymore? Agnes: I guess not. But wait a second! They turned the old chocolate factory building into a tourist place! Look at these cool restaurants and shops! I would love to go there! Grandfather: Hmm… There was another place I spent hours in – a museum of an 18th-century theatre. There was this aristocrat who turned his peasants into actors and turned the palace he lived in into a theatre. It was called… the Ostankino Palace. Is it still there? It has to be! Agnes: Let’s see… It is still there; it is still a museum… Grandfather: Good! Agnes: But … it’s been closed for reconstruction since 2013! Grandfather: Are you sure it’s still closed?
